name: Rechargeable Batteries
description: Guidelines for traveling with rechargeable batteries in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Rechargeable batteries are allowed. Spare lithium-ion rechargeable batteries must go in carry-on. NiMH/NiCad rechargeable batteries can be checked.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring rechargeable batteries on a plane?

travelTips: Rechargeable batteries are allowed. Spare lithium-ion rechargeable batteries must go in carry-on. NiMH/NiCad rechargeable batteries can be checked.

faq.question: Is rechargeable batteries allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Rechargeable Batteries is allowed in carry-on luggage. Rechargeable batteries are allowed. Spare lithium-ion rechargeable batteries must go in carry-on. NiMH/NiCad rechargeable batteries can be checked.

faq.question: Can you pack rechargeable batteries in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Rechargeable Batteries is not allowed in checked bags. Lithium rechargeable spare batteries are prohibited in checked bags. NiMH rechargeable batteries are allowed.
